description: Get the IDs and blueprint of currently selected elements on a specific canvas. Returns selected element IDs and their blueprint representation including descendants. A selection past 1,000 elements (descendants included) is summarized: counts by type (`countsByType`), union bounds (`worldBounds`), the first 100 ids and a `note`, beside the true `count`. Use `read` with a `scope` of ids or #refs for full subtrees. (External MCP clients: call `init` first for usage docs. Hosted-CLI and sub-agents have docs pre-loaded.)

canvasId.description: Canvas ID to get selection from. REQUIRED.

project.description: Optional: run THIS call against a project other than the session's bound one: a name or key from list_projects (or an unambiguous name/handle substring), or the absolute path of a project folder (one holding .bl files, or an empty one), which opens in the background and is added to list_projects. Unknown/ambiguous is refused with candidates.

name: get_selection
